name: Synn
message: 「Huh? What's this...? Could this wonderful smell mean--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Bacon and eggs made with two eggs. Crustless bread with heaps of margarine, also two slices. Mashed potaytuhs made from organic potatoes.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why is everything in the past tense!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Plus a vibrant fresh salad with a hundred ingredients and oil-free dressing. Freshly squeezed 100% orange juice straight from the farm. And for dessert, naturally--」

name: Synn
message: 「Nom nom... Delicious! Seconds, please! --Thanks for the meal!」

name: Misa
message: 「Why are you looking away!? I want you to stare at me more!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then please close your lovely legs first. I don't know where to look.」

name: Misa
message: 「*Blush*. Even if it's you looking... Eek, I actually said it out loud!\s04」

name: Misa
message: 「Geez, such a shy Student Council President.\s04」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Excuse me. Mr. Student Council President. If you'd like, please have this.」

name: Synn
message: 「A bento? Don't tell me it's for me?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「First tier: a full New Year's feast packed with herring roe. Second tier: the classic trio of tiered boxes--tempura, eel, and pork cutlet bowls.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Third tier, the climax: high-class hand-rolled sushi loaded with salmon roe and sea urchin. And crowning the end is, naturally, dessert. Inside is--」

name: Synn
message: 「Eating lunch before noon is the best!! Thank you for the meal!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You are most welcome, Mr. Student Council President.」

name: Ria
message: 「I don't have any money. So I can't buy anything.」

name: Ria
message: 「Red bean bun, jam bun, curry bread, melon bread, yakisoba bread, omu-soba bread, green pea paste bun, chocolate-vanilla twin bun, baguette. All of them.」

name: Ria
message: 「As expected of the Student Council President\S07」

name: Synn
message: 「What!? A meteorite is falling from the sky!?」

name: Synn
message: 「This is bad. At this rate, everyone will be in danger...」

name: Synn
message: 「Super... Ultimate... Move! Student Council President BEEEEAM!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew... Today's Student Council duties are done without a hitch. Now, time to have some fun~~」

name: Synn
message: 「All-you-can-sing, all-you-can-drink! Let's have a blast!! Let's enjoy our youth!!」

name: Synn
message: 「After all, the ultimate dinner is beefsteak. The knife cuts through with zero resistance, and the juices gush right out.」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you know, everyone? 'Bifuteki' is actually short for beefsteak.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa~ The Student Council President knows everything~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, that is only to be expected of the Student Council President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Heh. Your beefsteak will get cold while you're busy praising me.」
Since when was beefsteak so watery--
